_comment: marble_tower: Map 2's guard tower, the Bentham drawing's -- a tall slender stone shaft on two steps rising from the spike floor, a corbelled balcony with a balustrade (16 posts 0.15 square at the facet centres, a 0.15 x 0.15 rail 1.75..1.90 straight from post to post), a marble lantern with eight arched windows on Map 1's grid (bearings 25 + 45k, inner radius 6.86, sill 2.35, crown 7.00), a cornice and a conical cap. Origin = the guard-room datum as tower.glb: the room floor is z 1.70, the balcony floor 1.00 (a step under the sills; its rail stays under the guard's sight line to the lane), the foot z -26.35 (the spike floor, world y -1.0, when the scene's Tower node stands at y 25.35). One material, marble's packed 256 px atlas. MarbleTowerCollision rides in the .glb as a `-colonly` node (room floor, sill band, piers, window reveals, ceiling, outer face, balcony floor, an invisible band at r 9.825 from 1.00 to 1.90 in place of the balustrade, corbel, shaft, steps); Godot turns it into a StaticBody3D + ConcavePolygonShape3D and drops its mesh, so `surfaces` counts only what is drawn.
